crossRefs.note: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.
When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.
This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hachmoni
people.line: Father of Jehiel, one of David's family servants.

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon

translations.web: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
translations.bsb: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
translations.kjv: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
